A YouTube Music fix: songs in a queue play once, and Start mix starts a fresh mix. Website and docs: https://bong-water-water-bong.github.io/ytui/

## Download

| Platform | Package | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 (x64) | `ytui-v2026.10.20-windows-x86_64.zip` | Unzip and run `ytui.exe` in **Windows Terminal**. |
| Linux (x86_64) | `ytui-v2026.10.20-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `ytui-v2026.10.20-macos-arm64.tar.gz` | |

Each package holds `ytui` (or `ytui.exe`), `README.md`, `LICENSE` and `THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md`. You also need `yt-dlp`, `ffmpeg` and a JavaScript runtime (`deno` or Node.js) on your PATH, and a truecolour terminal. On Windows: `winget install yt-dlp.yt-dlp Gyan.FFmpeg DenoLand.Deno`.

Checksums are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

## What's fixed

- **Next no longer repeats the song:** signed in, YouTube Music sends every queued song together with its other version (the music video for an audio track, or the other way round), and ytui queued both, so Next played the same song again. Each song is now queued once.
- **Start mix starts a mix:** it now asks YouTube Music the same way its own Start mix button does. Before, it got the song's usual radio, which is the queue the song was already playing.
